{{Quote|I'll have her rebuilt before we head to Vadnay.|Phee Genoa|<ref name="Entombed">{{TBB|Entombed}}</ref>}}
'''Vadnay''' was a location in [[the galaxy]].<ref name="Entombed" /> Between [[19 BBY]] and [[18 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TBBDate|205}}</ref> [[Phee Genoa]] claimed to have a lead to an [[ancient chalice]] supposedly located on Vadnay, which had once belonged to the [[Kingdom of Elweys]] being lost over a [[millennium]] beforehand. The [[pirate]] stated she would have her [[droid]] [[MEL]]-221, who had been destroyed in the [[Kaldar Trinary system]], rebuilt before venturing to Vadnay.<ref name="Entombed" />
